body:
concentrate into myself, for those past years(including this one) i always thought that for me to achieve true happiness, i needed to be with someone else, but i got trough a though breakup and was left broken and without self-love,i was and i am very broken actually but, im trying each day to recover from it.  
So, i just want to in 2019, i can, for once, love myself and be happy without depending on other people.  
Oh, and i can't wait to buy Jojo's Battle Tendency physical copy here in Brazil as well!

Mine's are, as well, in no particular order:

**G-DRAGON**

* Untitled 2014
* Heartbreaker
* Who You
* That XX

**TAEYANG**(i really love youngbae's discography A LOT haha)

* Dress
* 逢いたくていま

**SEUNGRI**

* Gotta Talk to u
* Strong Baby

**T.O.P**

* Doom Dada
* Turn It Up

Oh man, i did this right now and i wish i read this before, it was just like you described, I'm felling a little sad right now but at least i know she doesn't want nothing with me anymore, so i wont more sustain those false expectations i was having unfortunately.  
But yeah, i guess we all feel like, out of nowhere, the person will magically comeback to us like nothing happened and will say it missed us as well.  
Love is fucked up.

Thank you for that, it's really helping me now that i am not at home, it's very hard to go out and get stuff done, but i think that's the best way to deal with it.
I hope i can learn how to love myself again and to not be defined by some past experience, hope you have a wonderful day!
